threat_event: Ransomware spreads from the corporate domain to SCADA, historians, and MES at Plants 2 and 5 and halts all lines and cold storage monitoring there
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT servers joined to the corporate domain; flat IT and OT networks; no EDR on OT hosts at these plants
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-M1 to SYS-M3 (Plants 2 and 5); BP-M01 to BP-M04
existing_controls: Group SOC and EDR on IT; perimeter firewall
treatment_plan: OT DMZ and move to the OT domain (POAM-001); EDR or allowlisting on OT hosts; offline backups (POAM-009)
owner: Meat Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: The integrator's shared always-on VPN account is used to reach SCADA at Plants 2 and 5
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared account; no MFA; always on; outside SYS-G5
existing_controls: Firewall allows the VPN only to the SCADA subnet
treatment_plan: Disable the account; integrator access only through SYS-G5 with named accounts and MFA (POAM-002)

threat_event: A cure (sodium nitrite) or brine formulation is changed in MES or the recipe master library
threat_source: Insider or external attacker with recipe access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared MES logins at Plants 2 and 5; no change alert to FSQA from the cloud recipe library
existing_controls: Two-person approval and named accounts at Plants 1, 3, 4, and 6
treatment_plan: Named accounts and two-person approval at Plants 2 and 5; library change alerts to plant FSQA

threat_event: OT backups at Plants 2 and 5 are lost with production systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups on domain-joined storage in the same server room; never restore-tested; PLC programs on engineering laptops
existing_controls: Nightly backups
treatment_plan: Offline and immutable copies; PLC program repository; quarterly restore tests as at the other plants (POAM-009)

threat_event: The Plant 5 refrigeration controller is reached through the contractor's cellular modem
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on cellular modem; default web credentials on the controller (P07)
existing_controls: Hardwired ammonia detection; PSM procedures
treatment_plan: Remove the modem; contractor access through SYS-G5; change credentials (POAM-002)

threat_event: The single controls integrator for Plants 2 and 5 is unavailable during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy contract with one small integrator; few in-house engineers know the acquired plants' systems
existing_controls: Division controls engineers cover in emergencies
treatment_plan: Document the plants' control systems; add the group's standard integrator as a second source

threat_event: CIP chemical is routed into the Plant 6 plant-based brine system during production through an HMI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The plant-based line's CIP manifold has no hardwired interlock (the meat brine systems do); shared HMI logins; not assessed in the 2024 vulnerability assessment
existing_controls: Physical access controls; CCTV at the brine room
treatment_plan: Hardwired CIP interlock; brine system as an actionable process step in the reanalysis (POAM-023)

threat_event: Electronic CCP records at Plants 2 and 5 are altered or incomplete without detection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Historian audit trails disabled; shared accounts
existing_controls: Pre-shipment review by FSQA
treatment_plan: Enable audit trails; named accounts; send historian events to the SIEM (POAM-004)

threat_event: Setpoint changes on HMIs cannot be attributed to a person at any plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator logins on 310 HMIs
existing_controls: MES changes attributed at four plants
treatment_plan: Badge or PIN sign-in on HMIs, phased by plant (POAM-003)

threat_event: Malware exploits the 24 unsupported HMIs at Plants 2 and 5
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported operating system; flat networks
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Application allowlisting; replacement in the 2027 capital plan (POAM-013)
owner: Meat Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: Plant cold storage alerts stop reaching on-call staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Depends on the group alert integration server; no plant-level fallback alerting
existing_controls: Historian alarms in the control rooms at four plants
treatment_plan: Local fallback alarms at all plants; group failover (GR-02)

threat_event: The Plant 6 food defense plan is found inadequate because it was not reanalyzed after the 2025 MES upgrade
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vulnerability assessment omitted control-system paths; no reanalysis after a significant change
existing_controls: Written 2024 plan; qualified individual in place
treatment_plan: Reanalysis including control-system paths; food defense sign-off in OT change control (POAM-007, POAM-023)

threat_event: AI vision inspection misses foreign material on one product type while staff rely on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Validation by product type not required before production; detection on bacon below target
existing_controls: Metal detector CCPs and manual inspection unchanged
treatment_plan: Product-type validation and conditions in P10; no reduction in manual inspection

threat_event: The AI vision vendor's remote tool on edge servers is used as a path into the control network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor remote tool at Plants 1, 3, and 4; model updates pushed without notice
existing_controls: Edge servers on a separate VLAN at Plants 1 and 3
treatment_plan: Vendor access only through SYS-G5; updates through change control

threat_event: Phishing gives an attacker a foothold on a plant office workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large hourly workforce with shared kiosk accounts
existing_controls: EDR; MFA; email filtering; awareness training
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Meat Processing security and compliance lead; existing controls are adequate
owner: Meat Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: Malware on removable media or an engineering laptop reaches PLCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineering laptops move between plants and the internet
existing_controls: EDR on engineering laptops
treatment_plan: Media scanning kiosks at each plant; dedicated OT engineering workstations

threat_event: Cloud administrator compromise is used to change formulations in the recipe master library
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Library administrators are cloud platform administrators; no change alert to FSQA
existing_controls: PAM for cloud administrators; MFA
treatment_plan: Separate library administration from platform administration; change alerts; signed releases

threat_event: Loss of the food safety records application blocks pre-shipment review at all six plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single application for all plants
existing_controls: Immutable backups in provider B; paper forms
treatment_plan: Annual failover exercise of SYS-M5 to provider B

threat_event: A disgruntled maintenance technician sabotages equipment or settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broad physical and HMI access during the sanitation shift
regulatory_driver: C-FOOD-AG-R01 (121.130(b)) for Plant 6; FSIS voluntary food defense guidance
existing_controls: Badge access; CCTV; termination procedure with same-day badge removal
treatment_plan: Named HMI accounts (MT-009); access reviews for sanitation shift roles

threat_event: After an MES restore, wrong labels or lot codes are applied and product is misbranded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No post-restore label verification step
existing_controls: Second-person label checks on manual labels
treatment_plan: Restart checklist with label and lot-code verification (P08)

threat_event: A failed ammonia detection sensor goes unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Detector tests tracked on paper
existing_controls: PSM mechanical integrity program
treatment_plan: Detector health into the historian and SOC

threat_event: Plant Wi-Fi used by production tablets bridges to OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets connect to both Wi-Fi and HMIs at Plant 2
existing_controls: WPA3-Enterprise Wi-Fi
treatment_plan: Separate OT wireless; remove tablets from HMI networks
owner: Meat Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: Formulations and process trade secrets are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Formulation sheets on division file shares readable by all plant office staff
existing_controls: Classification labels
treatment_plan: Restrict formulation shares to FSQA and controls engineering

threat_event: The Plant 6 food defense plan is disclosed and used as a map of vulnerable steps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan stored on a site share with broad access
existing_controls: Restricted label
treatment_plan: Move to the restricted FSQA library

threat_event: Temporary workers at Plant 6 actionable process steps lack food defense awareness training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agency workers start before training
existing_controls: Training at hire for employees
treatment_plan: Training before first shift for every worker at an actionable step

threat_event: An OT change is made without HACCP reassessment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT change control at Plants 2 and 5 lacks a HACCP check
existing_controls: HACCP check in change control at four plants
treatment_plan: Adopt the division change procedure at Plants 2 and 5

threat_event: A hurricane causes a power outage beyond generator fuel at a Florida plant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 72 hours of generator fuel; fuel contracts shared with other businesses
existing_controls: Generators; hurricane plan
treatment_plan: Priority fuel contracts; product transfer plan to other plants

threat_event: A plant WAN outage stops MES production orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single carrier at Plants 3 and 4
existing_controls: Standing schedules for 24 hours
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Meat Processing security and compliance lead; standing schedules cover the MTD
owner: Meat Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: A compromised integrator software update reaches PLCs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Updates installed by the integrator without integrity checks at Plants 2 and 5
existing_controls: Change control at four plants
treatment_plan: Signed updates and hash checks; updates through change control

threat_event: Default vendor passwords on OT devices at Plants 2 and 5 are used to change settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 testing (2026-08-15) found default passwords on 3 packaging HMIs at Plant 2 and on the Plant 5 refrigeration controller
existing_controls: None until found
treatment_plan: Changed during testing where safe; credential sweep at all plants
